how_to_use: Read the guide once. Fill the agreement template per team member. Log daily service and retail sales. Run the tier calculator at period end. Issue one payout statement per stylist. Log any question in the dispute log within 48 hours.
limitations: Built for commission payroll only. Does not compute payroll taxes, tip reporting, benefits, or deductions. Does not support booth rental accounting. Tier logic covers one threshold per period. Spreadsheet has no payroll software export.
long_description: A commission pay kit for independent salons and spas with commission staff: a daily service and retail sales log, a tier calculator with exact formulas, per-stylist payout statements, a dispute log, and a commission agreement template. Each payout line shows its arithmetic so staff can verify it. Illustrative walkthroughs show multi-rate math, tier bonuses, voids, and corrections step by step.
name: Salon Commission Pay Kit
outcome_statement: Pay each commission period from one verified log, with statements staff can check and a written record for every question.
problem_statement: Multi-rate commission math across services, retail, tiers, bonuses, and voids causes payday disputes that cost owners time and trust.
short_description: Commission payroll kit for salons and spas: sales log, tier calculator, payout statements, dispute log, and agreement template.
support: Email support for file access and formula questions. Response within two business days. Payroll processing and legal review are not included.
whats_included: Workbook spreadsheet with 4 sheets: Sales Log, Tier Calculator, Payout Statement, Dispute Log
3 print-ready templates: Payout Statement, Dispute Form, Commission Agreement

Small teams with service plus retail commission
